objects.name: Detection technique coverage: o365-email-new-inbox-rule-created
objects.description: The following analytic identifies the creation of new email inbox rules in an Office 365 environment. It detects events logged under New-InboxRule and Set-InboxRule operations within the o365_management_activity data source, focusing on parameters that may indicate mail forwarding, removal, or obfuscation. Inbox rule creation is a typical end-user activity however attackers also leverage this technique for multiple reasons.
